name: Mitten Extracts Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Permanent Marker + Blueberry Muffin
description:
Bold and sweet in all the right ways. Permanent Marker delivers a strong, complex profile while Blueberry Muffin brings smooth baked-berry sweetness to the mix.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
